summary: Shrink each panel's keep zones to the essential scripted action so lettering has room

keep.what: Nagoji's face and red turban
Nagoji's talwar hand and hilt
Dhanaji's face at Nagoji's shoulder
Chanda Sahib's riders wheeling away (core group)
Front Nair's hands and levelled matchlock lock
Second Nair's levelled matchlock toward riders

dropped: Old zone 1 (Nagoji whole torso and saddle): cut down to his face and his talwar hand. The red sash and saddle are costume and scenery.
Old zone 2 (Dhanaji whole torso): cut down to his face, which is all the beat needs to put him at Nagoji's shoulder. His sword arm and tunic are body.
Old zone 3 (left kneeling musketman, whole body): dropped. The two levelled matchlocks on the right already show the musket line, so this figure repeats them.
Old zone 4 (whole musket line with bodies and rocks): cut down to two hand-and-matchlock strips. The bodies, topknots and rocks are crowd and scenery.
Old zone 0 (riders and dust trail): cut to the core group of riders in the dust. The outer stragglers and the dust are scenery.
result.note: The keep zones now total about 9 percent of the frame, down from 42; both captions fit in the open sky at the top right (x 0.45-1.0, y 0-0.25), which no keep zone touches.

keep.what: Dhanaji's face and his hand wiping sweat with the cloth
Dhanaji's open hand gesturing out at the rocks and gullies
Nagoji's face
Nagoji's left hand gripping one bridle
Nagoji's right hand gripping the second bridle

dropped: Old zone 0 (Dhanaji seated, [0.1,0.3,0.37,0.45]): it spanned his whole torso and outstretched arm. I split it into two tight zones, one for his face plus the hand with the cloth and one for the gesturing hand.

Old zone 1 (hands, reins and the two lowered horse heads, [0.32,0.42,0.72,0.66]): too wide, since it took in both horses and Nagoji's sash and dhoti. Only the two hands on the bridles are kept. The horse heads are large and sit below y 0.4, away from the open sky and rock space the lettering will use.
Old zone 2 (Nagoji's body from shoulders to knees, [0.381,0.215,0.58,0.723]): a whole-body zone. I kept only his face and his two hands, which hold the reins.
result.note: The five tight zones cover about 3.5 percent of the frame, down from 24 percent, which frees the upper-right sky (about x 0.55-1.0, y 0-0.25) and the upper-left rocks for the caption and Dhanaji's two balloons.

keep.what: town gate, front wall and temple tower with the road entering the gate
road leaving the far side of the town onto the plains

dropped: Wall wings left of x0.45 and right of x0.72 (left corner towers, right bastions): repeated wall scenery, not needed to read the town and gate
Road below the gate in the foreground fields: scenery, and the road entry is still kept at the gate
result.note: Total keep area is about 6.7 percent (down from 13 percent); the sky band at y 0 to 0.25 is fully open for all four balloons.

keep.what: Nagoji's lamp-lit face in profile, looking northeast
clay oil lamp with flame, and Nagoji's hand on the parapet
lead Maratha riders under the big saffron swallow-tailed pennants

dropped: Far, receding end of the horse column (x 0.33-0.59, small distant riders and pennants): the lead group already shows the column and the pennants, and this frees the top-middle sky for captions
Lower horse bodies and the mist trail (y 0.24-0.42): the column reads from the pennants and the riders' upper bodies
Nagoji's body, sash and sword, the watchtower, palms, distant water and the lit fort courtyard: setting, not needed by the beat
result.note: Total about 8.4% (was 24%). Open sky at top-left and top-middle (x 0.02-0.57, y 0.01-0.18) and the lower parapet wall (x 0.48-0.75, y 0.80-0.97) can hold both captions without touching any zone.

keep.what: Nagoji's fingers pinching the wick in the clay lamp, with the smoke
Ramayyan and Dhanaji's heads, torsos and talking gesture in the lit doorway
Nagoji's head from behind with the red turban, facing the horizon

dropped: Zone 3 (Nagoji's shoulders and upper back): a whole-body area. The head zone already shows him seen from behind and facing the horizon, so the beat does not need this.
Lower legs and feet of Ramayyan and Dhanaji (old zone 1 went down to 0.87): their whole bodies are not needed. The heads, torsos and gesture show they are talking and unaware.
Zone 0 trimmed a little to fit the lamp bowl, the smoke and the pinching fingers. The forearm and wrist are now left out.
result.note: The zones now cover about 7.7 percent of the frame, down from 18. The open sky and treeline along the top-left (x 0 to 0.6, y 0 to 0.17) can hold both captions.

keep.what: Ramayyan's face (speaker, 86-char line)
Varma's face and earring stud (speaker)
Hand-off: Ramayyan's hands, palm-leaf bundle, Varma's open hand

dropped: Zone 1 (Varma's head and bare upper body): shrunk to his face only; the torso and necklaces are not needed for the beat
Zone 2 (Varma's outstretched arm): dropped the forearm and upper arm. His open hand stays protected inside the hand-off zone
Zone 3 (palm-leaf bundle): merged into the single hand-off zone so it is not counted twice
Zone 0 (hands passing the ola): kept but widened slightly to x0.325 so Ramayyan's knuckles fit, and now also holds the bundle and Varma's palm
result.note: Added Ramayyan's face, which was missing even though he speaks the long line. Total is now about 5.1 percent, down from 12. The roof and beams across the top third are clear for both balloons.

keep.what: chieftain's face, sideways glance and muttering mouth, with front topknot
Varma's face looking away, not at the chief
palm leaf in Varma's hands

dropped: Chieftain's torso, chest hand and earring area below the mouth: the beat only needs his face and sideways mutter
Varma's chest, necklaces, crossed legs and dais: whole-body detail not needed; only his averted face and the leaf matter
Seated nobles, standing guards, the back-of-head figure at right, ships, fort and pavilion scenery: not part of the beat
result.note: Three tight zones total about 6 percent of the frame, leaving the open sky band (x 0.40-0.66, y 0.08-0.30) and the upper right free for the CHIEF and two VARMA balloons.

keep.what: Varma's head, hair and profile face (ear stud, mustache), the over-the-shoulder anchor
Nagoji's turbaned face, red sash and sword hilt, small at the far end

dropped: Varma's lower shoulder, bare back and spear hand (0.30-0.40 y band): the head and profile alone set up the over-the-shoulder view
Nagoji's legs and boots: his face and upper body carry his identity; the lower figure is not needed to read him
Nair chieftains on both sides: a crowd, and they sit well clear of the open roof area where the balloon goes
Pillars, sea view, table with map, scrolls and coin tray: scenery and props the beat does not depend on

keep.what: Nagoji's face (speaker): eyes, moustache, mouth
Nagoji's right hand setting the gold coin on the small stack
brass tray of coins the stack is drawn from

dropped: Old zone 2 (hand + stack + tray union box): it was redundant and loose, so I split it into the tight hand/stack box and the tight tray box
Old zones 0 and 1: replaced by slightly adjusted tight boxes that fully contain the hand, the coin, the stack and the tray rim
Nair chieftains on either side: they are listeners, not speaking or acting, so balloons may overlap them
Nagoji's torso, turban crown, table, scrolls, inkpot, lamps, guards, coastline and ships: scenery and bodies the beat does not depend on
result.note: I added a keep zone for Nagoji's face because he is the speaker and the old zones left it out. The total is now about 3.5% of the frame, and the open wall at the top centre (about x 0.40-0.80, y 0.02-0.24) has room for both NAGOJI balloons.

keep.what: Varma's face and topknot, turned toward the sea
spear blade and Varma's hand gripping the shaft
ships on the open sea Varma is turning toward
left bearded chieftain's face as he rises
right standing chieftain's face looking to Varma

dropped: Varma full body zone [0.38,0.09,0.52,0.8]: the beat needs only his face, his grip and the spear, not the torso and mundu, so it was cut down to two tight zones (face; spear plus hand)
left foreground chieftain body [0.19,0.38,0.34,0.85]: a whole back and mundu; the rising action reads from the posture, so only the nearby bearded chieftain's face is kept
right foreground chieftain body [0.73,0.38,0.9,0.85]: a whole back seen from behind with no readable face; replaced by the standing chieftain's face at 0.815-0.852
open sea zone: kept only as a tight box around the four ships; the empty sky and water around them are left free for balloons
result.note: Total keep area falls from 27% to about 4.5%; the open sky at x 0.55-0.78, y 0.12-0.38 and at x 0.48-0.53 is free for both VARMA balloons.

keep.what: old grey-haired Nair's face looking up and nodding to Nagoji
Nagoji's turbaned face
second Nair's narrowed-eyes face watching him pass

dropped: Nagoji's full body (zone 1 cut from y 0.10-0.90 down to his head): his whole figure walking between the fire groups is the scene itself, and the face is what the reader has to see
Old Nair's torso, shoulders and the cookpot area: the nod is in his face
Second Nair's torso and arms: the narrowed eyes are the story detail, and he does no scripted hand action
Cookfires, the other groups, horses, the hall and the sky: background the beat does not depend on
result.note: Total drops from 19% to about 3%; the night sky at upper right (x 0.50-0.85, y 0.00-0.18) and upper left above the thatch are clear spaces for all three captions.

black sea horizon, empty of Dutch ships

dropped: Nagoji's full body, sword, sash and boots on the rise: the back view reads from the head and turban, and the body is not part of the scripted action
Lower sea, surf and beach (old zone 1 below y 0.5): scenery; only the empty horizon carries the 'no ships' point
Rocky rise, burning camp, tents and palms: scenery the beat does not depend on
result.note: Keep zones now total about 7.3 percent; the 136-char caption fits in the open night sky top right (about x 0.40-0.98, y 0.02-0.36) without touching either zone.

captive's manacled wrists and chain
officer's hands counting coin, with stacks on the cloth
counting officer's face

result.note: Keep zones went from about 19 percent of the frame to about 5.8 percent, leaving the dark tent roof (x 0.20-0.88, y 0-0.20) open for both captions.

main camp fires and figures he walks toward
pale beach curving away empty into the dark
